recipes.title: Artichoke Chicken
recipes.summary: Chicken marinated in Italian dressing, topped with cheesy artichoke dip, and baked. Six ingredients: chicken, Italian dressing, artichokes, mayonnaise, garlic, and Parmesan cheese. Can be assembled earlier in the day and baked when ready. Ready in under 30 minutes. Low-carb, keto, and gluten-free.

steps.text: Marinate chicken breasts in Italian dressing a few hours to overnight.
Preheat oven to 375°F.
Heat olive oil in non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Remove chicken from marinade and cook 2 minutes per side. Place chicken on foil lined baking sheet.
In a medium bowl, mix together chopped artichoke hearts, Parmesan cheese, mayonnaise, and garlic powder. Spread artichoke mixture evenly on top of chicken.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until juices run clear.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Breasts
recipes.summary: Tender, juicy baked chicken breasts seasoned with a simple five-ingredient pantry rub and roasted at high heat. Five minutes of prep and under 20 minutes in the oven for an easy weeknight dinner.

ingredients.text: boneless, skinless chicken breasts (about 4 medium size breasts)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Pat the chicken dry with paper towels, then pound the breasts to an even thickness of about 1 inch.

Pour the olive oil into a 13x9-inch baking dish. Coat the chicken lightly in the oil, then arrange the breasts side by side in the dish, alternating direction so they fit without overlapping. Use a dish rated for high heat.
In a small bowl, whisk together the salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and smoked paprika. Sprinkle over both sides of the chicken and rub it in with your hands.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes, until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the thickest part registers 160°F. Larger or thicker breasts will need longer.
Tent with foil and rest 5 to 10 minutes before slicing. The temperature will rise to 165°F as it sits. Slice against the grain and spoon the pan juices over the top.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon with Lemon and Herbs
recipes.summary: A elegant and healthy baked salmon fillet topped with fresh lemon juice, dill, and garlic. This restaurant-quality dish is simple to prepare and pairs beautifully with roasted vegetables.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place salmon fillets skin-side down on the prepared baking sheet.
Drizzle salmon with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Distribute minced garlic, fresh dill, and thyme evenly over each fillet.
Top each salmon fillet with a few lemon slices.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes until salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Serve hot with additional fresh lemon wedges on the side.

recipes.title: Crispy Beef Tacos
recipes.summary: Delicious crispy beef tacos loaded with seasoned ground beef, fresh toppings, and tangy lime crema. A crowd-pleasing favorite that's perfect for casual entertaining or quick weeknight dinners.

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add ground beef and cook, breaking it up as it cooks, until browned, about 5-7 minutes. Drain excess fat if needed.
Add taco seasoning and water according to packet instructions. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Warm taco shells according to package directions.
In a small bowl, mix sour cream with lime juice and cilantro to make lime crema.
Assemble tacos: Place seasoned beef in warm shells, then top with lettuce, tomato, cheese, and lime crema.
Serve immediately with additional lime wedges and your favorite salsa.

recipes.title: Chicken Stir Fry with Vegetables
recipes.summary: A quick and healthy stir fry loaded with tender chicken and fresh vegetables in a savory soy ginger sauce. Perfect weeknight dinner served over rice.

ingredients.text: chicken breast, sliced into thin strips

steps.text: In a small bowl, mix soy sauce, sesame oil, chicken broth, rice vinegar, and cornstarch to create sauce.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat.
Add chicken strips and cook until golden and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Remove from wok and set aside.
Add remaining tablespoon of oil to the wok. Add broccoli, bell pepper, and onion. Stir fry for 5 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Add minced garlic and ginger, cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Return chicken to the wok and pour in the sauce. Toss everything together and cook for 2-3 minutes until sauce thickens.
Serve immediately over steamed white or brown rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.summary: A creamy and aromatic Indian chicken dish made with tender chicken in a rich tomato-based sauce with warming spices. Serve with rice or naan bread for an authentic experience.

steps.text: In a bowl, combine 1/2 cup yogurt, 1 tablespoon garam masala, 1 tablespoon cumin, and 2 tablespoons paprika. Add chicken pieces and marinate for at least 20 minutes.
Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Working in batches, cook marinated chicken until golden, about 5-7 minutes per batch. Set aside.
In the same skillet, heat remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in remaining spices (2 tablespoons garam masala, 1 tablespoon cumin, 1 tablespoon paprika) and tomato paste. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and bring to a simmer. Cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in coconut milk and cooked chicken. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in remaining 1/2 cup yogurt and lime juice. Heat through without boiling.
Season with salt to taste and serve hot over rice or with naan, garnished with fresh cilantro.

recipes.title: Classic Beef Chili
recipes.summary: A hearty and flavorful beef chili with beans, perfect for cold evenings. This traditional recipe combines ground beef with a rich blend of spices, tomatoes, and kidney beans for a warming and satisfying meal.

ingredients.text: Optional toppings: shredded cheese, sour cream, chopped cilantro, diced onions

steps.text: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a wooden spoon, until browned and no longer pink, about 6-8 minutes. Drain excess fat if necessary.
Add the diced onion and bell pepper to the pot. Cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Add the chili powder, cumin, paprika, cayenne pepper (if using), salt, and black pepper. Stir well to coat the meat and vegetables with the spices, cooking for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in the diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, and beef broth. Stir to combine all ingredients.
Add the drained kidney beans and stir them into the mixture.
Bring the chili to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for at least 1 hour, stirring occasionally. The longer it simmers, the better the flavors will meld together.
Taste and adjust seasonings as needed. Add more salt, pepper, or chili powder to your preference.
Serve hot with your choice of toppings such as shredded cheese, sour cream, chopped cilantro, or diced onions.

recipes.title: Fudgy Chocolate Brownies
recipes.summary: Rich, decadent fudgy brownies with a perfect chewy texture. These homemade brownies are loaded with chocolate flavor and perfect for satisfying any sweet craving.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and line a 9x9 inch square baking pan with parchment paper.
In a double boiler or microwave, melt butter and chopped chocolate together, stirring until smooth. Let cool slightly.
In a bowl, whisk together granulated sugar, eggs, and vanilla extract until well combined.
Stir the melted chocolate mixture into the egg mixture until combined.
In another bowl, sift together flour, cocoa powder, salt, and baking powder.
Fold the dry ingredients into the chocolate mixture until just combined. Do not overmix.
Pour batter into prepared baking pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out with a few moist crumbs.
Cool in pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely.
Cut into 12 squares and serve. Store in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

recipes.title: Crockpot Creamy Chicken + Rice
recipes.summary: Nutritious crockpot comfort food — seared chicken with brown rice, veggies, and a creamy Greek yogurt–Dijon finish. Convenient clean-eating dinner with leftovers for meal prep.

ingredients.text: boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch bite-sized pieces
sea salt and fresh ground black pepper, to taste
green onions, thinly sliced to garnish

steps.text: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add chicken and sear 2-3 minutes until golden but not fully cooked.
Season with salt and pepper; add garlic and chicken to the slow cooker.
Stir in rice, carrots, onions, corn, and peas.
Add broth and stir. Cook on HIGH 3-4 hours or LOW 6-8 hours.
Whisk Greek yogurt and Dijon together.
When cooking is done, stir in yogurt-mustard mixture; season to taste.
Serve warm with sliced green onions.

recipes.title: Crockpot Mexican Quinoa Tacos
recipes.summary: Easy meatless (or vegan) crockpot quinoa tacos — dump everything in the slow cooker, no chopping or sautéing required. Flavor-packed with black beans, fire-roasted tomatoes, enchilada sauce, corn, and taco seasoning. Nutritious plant-based protein perfect for taco night or meal prep. Great vegetarian option alongside your chicken recipes.

ingredients.text: corn or flour tortillas + desired toppings (avocado, cheese, cilantro, lime, etc.)

steps.text: Rinse quinoa if needed. Generously spray a 6-quart slow cooker with cooking spray (or use a liner).
Add quinoa, stock, black beans, tomatoes (undrained), enchilada sauce, corn, and taco seasoning to the crockpot. Stir well to combine.
Cover and cook on HIGH for 2.5–4 hours until quinoa has popped and absorbed most liquid (do not use low setting).
Stir gently, taste, and adjust seasoning with salt/pepper if needed.
Warm tortillas. Fill with quinoa mixture and load up with favorite toppings (lime, avocado, cilantro, cheese, etc.).
For meal prep: Store filling separately (refrigerate up to 4 days; reheat with splash of water). Assemble tacos fresh. Excellent meatless option for variety in weekly plans.

recipes.title: 3-Ingredient Crock Pot Pulled Chicken
recipes.summary: Super simple 3-ingredient clean eating pulled chicken made in the crockpot. Sweet-tangy flavor from salsa and balsamic. Versatile for tacos, salads, sandwiches, bowls, or lettuce wraps. Ideal for large weekend batch cooking and meal prepping lunches all week long. Clean, healthy, and endlessly adaptable.

ingredients.text: boneless, skinless chicken breasts or tenders

steps.text: Add chicken breasts/tenders to the slow cooker.
Pour the salsa (or tomato sauce) and balsamic vinegar over the chicken.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6 hours or HIGH for 4 hours until chicken shreds easily.
Shred the chicken directly in the pot using two forks, or for speed use a stand mixer with paddle attachment (1 minute on low after cooling slightly).
Stir the shredded chicken back into the sauce/juices to coat thoroughly.
For weekend BBQ twist: After shredding, transfer to a grill-safe pan or foil and finish on the grill for smoky flavor, or use as base for BBQ chicken sandwiches.
Meal prep magic: Portion into containers for salads, quinoa bowls, tacos, or wraps. Keeps 4-5 days in fridge or freeze up to 6 weeks. Perfect for supporting weekday lunches from one big weekend cook.

recipes.title: Southwest Chicken Crockpot Recipe
recipes.summary: Wholesome shredded chicken with black beans, pinto beans, corn, and tomatoes — easy clean-eating slow cooker dinner.

ingredients.text: pinto beans, rinsed and drained (or ~1 1/3 cup home-cooked)
black beans, rinsed and drained (or ~1 1/3 cup home-cooked)
diced tomatoes in juice (low sodium best)

steps.text: Place chicken breasts on the bottom of the slow cooker.
Pour tomatoes and salsa over that.
Layer on the beans.
Add the corn.
Cover securely.
Cook on low 5-7 hours, until chicken falls apart when stirred.
Shred chicken by stirring, or use forks / mixer on lowest speed so beans stay intact.
Serve on its own, with corn chips, over rice, or as burrito filling.

recipes.title: Crockpot Baked Ziti
recipes.summary: Layered crockpot baked ziti where the penne goes in uncooked and cooks right in the sauce. Layers of marinara, a basil-ricotta filling, and parmesan, finished with melted mozzarella. Feeds a crowd (needs a 6-quart or larger slow cooker) and works well for a late Thursday dinner, meal prep, and weekend batch cooking.

metadata.cookTime: 2 hours 30 minutes high (2-3 hours high, or about 3-4 hours low)

steps.text: Stir the ricotta, eggs, and chopped basil together in a bowl until evenly combined.
In a large bowl, mix both jars of pasta sauce with the tomato sauce. You will use this in three roughly equal portions (about 2 1/3 cups each).
Grate the parmesan, and split the uncooked penne into three equal piles so the layers cook evenly.
Grease or spray the inside of a 6-quart (or larger) slow cooker.
First layer: spread about 2 1/3 cups of sauce over the bottom, scatter one pile of penne over it, spoon on half of the ricotta mixture and spread it out, then sprinkle with 1 cup of parmesan.
Second layer: repeat with another 2 1/3 cups of sauce, the second pile of penne, the rest of the ricotta mixture, and the remaining 1 cup of parmesan.
Top with the last pile of penne and cover it completely with the remaining sauce, spreading it so no noodles are left dry.
Cover and cook on HIGH for 2-3 hours (about 2 1/2 hours is usually right) until the pasta is al dente. On LOW, plan on roughly 3-4 hours and check so the noodles don't turn mushy.
For the final 15-30 minutes, sprinkle the mozzarella over the top, cover, and let it melt.
Serve as is or with red pepper flakes, garlic bread, roasted vegetables, or a side salad.

Notes: A full batch will not fit in a 4-quart slow cooker; halve the recipe for that size. Cottage cheese or cream cheese can stand in for the ricotta, and asiago can replace the mozzarella. Browned Italian sausage can be added for a meatier version. Leftovers keep 4-5 days in an airtight container in the fridge.

recipes.title: Filipino Chicken Adobo (Crockpot Version)
recipes.summary: Authentic Filipino Chicken Adobo made easy in the slow cooker. Tangy, savory, garlicky perfection with vinegar, soy sauce, and bay leaves. Perfect for meal prep, weekend batch cooking, or as a base for lunches. Stovetop option also available but crockpot is set-it-and-forget-it.

ingredients.text: boneless skinless chicken thighs (preferred) or cut-up whole chicken

steps.text: Optional but recommended: Combine chicken, vinegar, water, soy sauce, garlic, bay leaves, and pepper in a bowl. Marinate in fridge overnight or at least 20-30 min.
Place chicken and all marinade ingredients into the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6 hours or HIGH for 3 hours until chicken is very tender.
Remove chicken to a plate. Pour sauce into a skillet or saucepan, bring to a boil, and reduce by about half (5-10 min) to thicken and concentrate flavors. (Optional but recommended for best taste).
Shred or chop chicken and return to reduced sauce in crockpot or bowl. Stir to coat well.
Serve over rice or quinoa. For meal prep: Divide into containers with rice and veggies for grab-and-go lunches. Excellent flavor that improves next day.

recipes.title: 5-Ingredient Garlic Butter Quinoa
recipes.summary: Super easy one-pan garlic butter quinoa side dish with just 5 ingredients. Buttery, flavorful, and versatile — pairs perfectly with any main like pulled chicken, adobo, or Asian sesame chicken. Ready in 20 minutes. Excellent for meal prep batches and weekday lunches.

steps.text: Add all ingredients to a small saucepan.
Bring to a boil, stirring until the butter melts.
Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove from heat, fluff with a fork, and let stand covered for 5 minutes.
Serve as a side with your favorite mains. For meal prep: Make a double batch and portion into containers — reheats beautifully for lunches alongside protein like pulled chicken or adobo.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Greek Salad
recipes.summary: A fresh and vibrant Greek salad with crisp vegetables, creamy feta cheese, Kalamata olives, and tangy lemon vinaigrette. Light, healthy, and perfect for warm summer days.

steps.text: In a large bowl, combine cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red bell pepper, and red onion.
Add Kalamata olives and crumbled feta cheese to the vegetables.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, lemon juice, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Pour dressing over salad and toss gently to combine.
Top with fresh chopped parsley.
Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to serve. Toss again before serving if dressing has settled.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Cheesy Cauliflower Potato Soup
recipes.summary: Easy gluten-free one-pot Instant Pot dinner — creamy potato, cheese, and bacon with cauliflower for fiber and a lighter bowl.

ingredients.text: potatoes (yellow or white), peeled, cored, cut into ~2-inch chunks
cauliflower, leaves removed, chopped into large chunks
bacon, chopped (or low-sodium substitute); reserve some for garnish

steps.text: Set Instant Pot to SAUTE (use + adjust as needed).
Add bacon and garlic; cook ~4 minutes until bacon lightly browned. Cook enough bacon to reserve some for garnish if desired.
Drain grease; set aside garnish bacon.
Add potatoes, cauliflower, and chicken stock. Seal lid/vent.
MANUAL high pressure 10 minutes. Turn pot off.
Natural release 10 minutes, then quick release until fully depressurized.
Add milk and 1 1/4 cup cheese. Mash with potato masher or immersion blender to desired consistency; add more broth if needed.
Serve topped with remaining cheese and bacon crumbles.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken and Brown Rice (One-Pot)
recipes.summary: Comforting one-pot Instant Pot meal with tender chicken thighs, brown rice, carrots, mushrooms, and a creamy savory sauce. Kid- and family-friendly, nutritious, and minimal cleanup. Perfect for busy weeknights or batch cooking. (Primarily Instant Pot; adaptable notes included.)

ingredients.text: boneless skinless chicken thighs (or breasts, halved)
cream of chicken soup (homemade or canned)

steps.text: Press Sauté on Instant Pot. Add olive oil and onion; cook ~3 minutes. Cancel Sauté.
Layer in this order: garlic, rinsed brown rice, chicken, carrots, mushrooms.
In a bowl, whisk together broth, cream of chicken soup, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper. Pour over ingredients in pot.
Place thyme sprigs on top. Seal lid, set to High Pressure / Manual for 25 minutes.
Quick release pressure carefully. Open lid, remove thyme stems, strip leaves into pot, and stir (shred chicken slightly if desired).

Serve warm. For meal prep: Portions reheat well; makes a big batch for lunches or family dinners. (Note: Primarily Instant Pot recipe; for crockpot adaptation try low 6-8 hrs with adjusted liquid, though results may vary.)

recipes.title: Instant Pot Panera Mac and Cheese
recipes.summary: Easy Instant Pot copycat of Panera's mac and cheese — creamy white cheddar and American cheese with a touch of Dijon, ready in under 20 minutes.

ingredients.text: milk (or start with 1/2 cup for less creamy; add more as desired)
freshly shredded white cheddar cheese (about 2 rounded cups)
extra butter and pinch of salt to taste if pasta was drained

steps.text: Place pasta, water, salt, and butter in Instant Pot; stir. Seal. Pressure/manual 4 minutes (~10 min to pressurize).
Quick-release carefully. If water spurts, close valve briefly, wait ~15s, release in short intervals until float drops.
If significant water remains, gently pour most off (keep a colander handy).
Stir in milk, white cheddar, American cheese; if drained, add butter/salt to taste. Stir in Dijon; optional pepper and hot sauce.
Use Warm to melt cheese if needed. For less creamy, start with 1/2 cup milk. Serve.

recipes.title: Leftover Turkey Corn Chowder
recipes.summary: This leftover turkey corn chowder comes together in about 30 minutes and is the most delicious way to use up that leftover Thanksgiving turkey. It uses both cream-style corn and whole-kernel sweet corn. Also works with leftover shredded chicken or rotisserie chicken.

ingredients.text: shredded leftover fully cooked turkey (may sub shredded leftover fully cooked chicken)
low sodium chicken broth or vegetable broth

steps.text: In a large stock pot combine cream style corn, whole kernel corn, broth, celery, bell peppers, potatoes, Italian seasoning, and garlic powder.
Cover and simmer over medium heat for 20-25 minutes until potatoes are tender and easily pierced with a fork.
Stir in turkey and season with salt and pepper. When turkey is heated through, serve and garnish with fresh parsley or thyme as desired.
Note: This also works with leftover shredded chicken or rotisserie chicken.

recipes.title: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
recipes.summary: An elegant and creamy mushroom risotto made with Arborio rice, white wine, and earthy mushrooms. This Italian classic is luxurious yet surprisingly easy to prepare.

steps.text: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until golden and their liquid is released, about 8-10 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside.
In a large, heavy-bottomed pot, heat 1 tablespoon butter and 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add Arborio rice and stir constantly for 1-2 minutes to toast slightly.
Pour in white wine and stir until mostly absorbed.
Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly. Wait until each addition is mostly absorbed before adding the next, about 18-20 minutes total.
When rice is creamy and tender, remove from heat and stir in remaining 2 tablespoons butter, Parmesan cheese, and cooked mushrooms.
Season to taste and serve immediately, garnished with fresh parsley.

recipes.title: Pasta Carbonara
recipes.summary: An authentic Italian pasta dish with a creamy egg sauce, crispy pancetta, and Pecorino Romano cheese. This classic Roman recipe is simple yet elegant, featuring minimal ingredients combined perfectly.

steps.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta until al dente, about 8-10 minutes.
While pasta cooks, fry the diced pancetta in a large skillet over medium-high heat until crispy, about 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
In a bowl, whisk together eggs, Pecorino Romano cheese, and black pepper until well combined.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta cooking water. Drain the cooked pasta.
Add the hot drained pasta to the skillet with pancetta off the heat. Toss to combine.
Pour the egg mixture over the pasta while stirring constantly. The residual heat will cook the eggs into a creamy sauce.
If the sauce is too thick, add reserved pasta water a splash at a time to reach desired consistency.
Serve immediately topped with additional Pecorino Romano and cracked black pepper.

recipes.title: Easy Rosemary Garlic White Bean Soup
recipes.summary: Eight-ingredient rosemary garlic white bean soup with rich, bold flavor — quick stovetop weeknight soup (vegan-friendly with veg broth).

ingredients.text: freshly cracked black pepper to taste

steps.text: Purée one can of cannellini beans with its liquid until smooth; drain the other two cans.
Mince garlic; sauté in olive oil over medium ~1 minute until fragrant.
Add puréed beans, drained beans, broth, rosemary, thyme, crushed red pepper, and black pepper; stir.
Cover, bring to a boil over medium-high; then medium-low, uncover, simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Smash beans slightly to thicken; salt to taste if needed. Serve hot with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Sample Lemon Pasta
recipes.summary: Bright lemon pasta with parmesan and herbs.

steps.text: Cook pasta according to package instructions.
Reserve some pasta water.
Combine lemon, butter, and cheese off heat.
Toss pasta with sauce, adding pasta water to loosen.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Asian Sesame Chicken
recipes.summary: Slow Cooker Asian Sesame Chicken is an easy, dump & go 4-ingredient chicken recipe made in the slow cooker. Sweet, savory, and perfect for busy weeknights or weekend meal prep. Serve over rice, quinoa, or noodles for a complete meal. Great base for lunches throughout the week.

ingredients.text: Asian toasted sesame dressing (Kraft or similar)
chopped green onions and sesame seeds for garnish

steps.text: Spray slow cooker insert with cooking spray. Lay chicken breasts in the bottom (cut large ones in half if needed).
In a bowl, mix together the Asian sesame dressing, apricot preserves, and onion soup mix packet. Stir with a fork until combined.
Pour the sauce mixture evenly over the chicken in the crockpot.
Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours until chicken is tender and cooked through.
Shred or slice the chicken and return to the sauce. Stir to coat.
Serve over cooked rice, quinoa, noodles, or cauliflower rice. Drizzle with extra sauce and garnish with green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
For meal prep: Portion into containers with rice/quinoa for easy weekday lunches. Stores well in fridge 4-5 days or freeze.

recipes.title: Classic Carnitas Recipe (Slow Cooker)
recipes.summary: Slow cooker carnitas simmered until falling-apart tender with a special pork rub — crispy finish optional. Great for weekend batch cooking and taco night.

ingredients.text: onion (white or yellow), cut into quarters

steps.text: Combine rub ingredients; rub over entire surface of pork.
Place pork in slow cooker fat side up. Add oranges, carrots, onion, bay leaves; pour chicken stock and orange juice over; cover.
Cook on low 10 hours or high 6 hours.
Transfer pork to platter with slotted spoon; cool slightly; shred by hand or two forks. Best crispy.
Discard cooked orange and vegetables from liquid; reserve liquid.
In a large skillet over high heat, fry shredded meat in batches with a little oil, adding ~1/4 cup cooking liquid per batch; simmer until liquid evaporates and meat is crispy/caramelized.
Serve with hot tortillas and desired toppings (refried beans, onions, cilantro, limes, salsas, guacamole, etc.).

recipes.title: 4-Ingredient Slow Cooker Salsa Verde Chicken
recipes.summary: Simple 4-ingredient slow cooker salsa verde chicken — dump-and-go, shreds easily, great for tacos, bowls, and meal prep.

ingredients.text: beer (use gluten-free beer or chicken broth for gluten-free)
jalapeño, stem removed and diced (optional; leave seeds in for extra heat)

steps.text: Add chicken to the slow cooker. Top with salsa verde and beer, sprinkle with cumin, and season with generous pinches of salt and a pinch of pepper. Turn chicken so both sides are coated. Cover. Cook 3-4 hours on high or 7-8 hours on low.

Chicken is ready when it shreds easily with a fork. Shred in the slow cooker and toss with the juices. Remove with a slotted spoon and serve warm. Or store shredded chicken sealed in the fridge up to 5 days or freezer up to 3 months.
Note: For gluten-free, use gluten-free beer or replace beer with chicken broth.

recipes.title: tomato soup
recipes.summary: good soup

steps.text: blend tomatoes
heat on stove

recipes.title: Creamy Vegetable Curry
recipes.summary: A fragrant and creamy vegetable curry made with coconut milk, aromatic spices, and fresh vegetables. This vegetarian dish is flavorful, satisfying, and naturally gluten-free.

steps.text: Heat coconut oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and ginger, cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add curry powder and turmeric, stir well to coat vegetables, cook for 1 minute.
Add cauliflower, potatoes, and carrots. Stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Pour in coconut milk and vegetable broth. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer uncovered for 20-25 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Stir in lime juice and season with salt to taste.
Serve hot over rice, garnished with fresh cilantro.

recipes.title: white rice
recipes.summary: good rice

steps.text: pour rice into pot
cover rice with water to a knuckle
